comment: Per-file type error counts for `tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json`.
`typecheck:tests` is a known-red tree (1829 errors across 184 files); a single total lets
a clean file go dirty as long as another file improves, which is not a ratchet. This file
records what each file currently costs, so `scripts/typecheck-per-file.js` can require:
- a file absent from this list must have ZERO errors (new failures are blocked anywhere)
- a file present must not EXCEED its recorded count (improvement is always allowed)
Improving a file? Re-run the gate with --update to lower its number — the ratchet should
